injury: transverse cuts halfway between head apex and pharynx and halfway between pharynx and tail end

intervention.description: Trunk fragments placed in praziquantel 70 uM (DMSO stock) for 48 h, then spring water.
intervention.timing: immediately after amputation (after ~3 min wound closure)

notes: Text: 'EC50=87 (+-) 11% bipolar fragments, 70uM PZQ for 48 hours' with citation 20 (Nogi et al. 2009); the value is likely restated from that earlier paper, not new data. The protocol section uses 90 uM for 24-48 h but the quoted number is for 70 uM 48 h. Only bipolar fraction given; n not given. Action/target assigned by extractor (paper does not state target here).

readout.method: scoring of head/tail identity of regenerated trunk fragments

source.location: Protocol section 4, Representative results (text); Fig 1B image only
source.title: Pharmacological and Functional Genetic Assays to Manipulate Regeneration of the Planarian Dugesia japonica
